headline: Saudi Defences Say Four Drones Were Destroyed Over Ras Tanura
deck: The coalition said it struck Houthi operational capabilities at Hodeidah port as the Houthis threatened Saudi Red Sea ports.
body: Reuters reported that Yemen’s Houthis said they attacked the Ras Tanura refinery and Riyadh’s financial district. Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed four drones over Ras Tanura, the Saudi-led coalition said [E1][E2][E3][E7][E10][E12].
Fragments fell during the interceptions, and the coalition’s initial assessment reported no casualties or injuries [E8][E11].

The Saudi-led coalition carried out strikes at Hodeidah port, where Major General Turki Al-Maliki, the coalition’s spokesperson, said operational capabilities were targeted. Al-Maliki said targeting civilians and civilian objects would meet a firm response [E4][E5][E6].

The Houthis said Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports would become targets if Hodeidah port were bombarded [E9]. Since the paper’s 21 November report that the Houthis said they were striking Saudi targets including Riyadh, the current exchange adds the claimed Ras Tanura attack and the coalition’s Hodeidah strikes [E13][E1][E4].
